events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock icon birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic voice of Oasis, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll star birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis track?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, on this day in 1962.

angles.name: 007 celebration
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. Happy James Bond Day! What's your favourite Bond film or theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy legend birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Python or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the passing of the one and only Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain legendary.

angles.name: Queen frontman tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, the music world lost a true showman. Today, we remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their career.

angles.name: Album milestone
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived, pushing boundaries and influencing generations.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the tragic passing of John Lennon, a global icon whose legacy continues to resonate.

angles.name: Lennon tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world lost a voice of peace and imagination. Remembering John Lennon today.
